title: Cosmic Wolf Vision
description: A glowing blue wolf stands on a rocky cliff overlooking a colorful tiled path where two smaller blue wolves walk forward. A massive ethereal wolf with a starry purple mane rises from the waterfall mist, facing a cracked green planet suspended in a grid-patterned sky above a wooden treehouse built into the rocks.
prompt: A majestic glowing blue wolf stands on a rocky cliff edge overlooking a cracked colorful tiled path in a barren landscape. Two smaller luminous blue wolves walk along the path. A giant ethereal cosmic wolf with a flowing purple mane filled with stars emerges from turquoise waterfall mist. A large cracked green planet floats in a grid sky with swirling aurora clouds. A wooden treehouse is built into the rocky cliff beside the waterfall. Fantasy digital painting style with vibrant glowing effects.
